metrics.definition: Number of goal events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: goals

metrics.definition: Number of shot events, any outcome in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: shots

metrics.definition: Number of shot events with the outcome goal or saved in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: shots on target

metrics.definition: Number of corner events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: corners

metrics.definition: Number of foul events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: fouls

metrics.definition: Number of yellow card events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: yellow cards

metrics.definition: Number of red card events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: red cards

metrics.definition: Number of penalty events with the outcome scored in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: penalties scored

metrics.definition: Number of penalty events with the outcome saved in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: penalties taken and saved

metrics.definition: Number of penalty events with the outcome missed in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: penalties missed

metrics.definition: Number of substitution events in the claim range for the subject (the team, and the player if one is named).
metrics.label: substitutions

metrics.definition: The team's share of pass and dribble events in the claim range; 0.5 when there are none.
metrics.label: possession

metrics.definition: The team's share of final-third entries in the claim range; 0.5 when there are none. An entry is an on-ball event at least 70 from the team's own goal line (pitch length 105) after play was outside that zone.
metrics.label: territorial share

metrics.definition: The team's goals at the end of the claim range.
metrics.label: goals

metrics.definition: The team's goals minus the opponent's goals at the end of the claim range.
metrics.label: goal margin

metrics.definition: The lowest goal margin for the team at any event in the claim range.
metrics.label: largest deficit

metrics.definition: Starting line-up size minus the team's red cards up to the end of the claim range.
metrics.label: players on the pitch

metrics.definition: (team pressure − opponent pressure) / (sum of both) over the last 10 minutes played; pressure = 3 × shots + 1 × final-third entries + 2 × corners. 0 when the sum is below 6.
metrics.label: pressure balance over the last 10 minutes of play
